tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page and post background. Studio is the warm cream of the workshop wall; Neon night is the studio after dark, for launches, reels covers and evening events.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, details blocks, product tags, the back of the business card.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: The heritage colour carried over from the original logo. Large fills: avatar disc, poster panels, tag fronts. Text on blush is always on-blush (ink). Never set neon text on blush (3.3:1).

tokens.name: blush-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet tint behind photos, chips and callouts.

tokens.name: neon
tokens.usage: The signature colour of the neon sign. Logo ink, links, primary buttons, the one highlighted word in a headline. Text-safe on canvas, paper and blush-soft in both themes (4.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: neon-glow
tokens.usage: The lit tube. Decorative only: glows, rings, the blossom on dark grounds. Never body text on Studio.

tokens.name: on-neon
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a neon fill (buttons, date stamps). 5.9:1 in Studio, 6.3:1 in Neon night.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on canvas, paper and blush-soft (13:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, dates, fine print, on canvas, paper and blush-soft (5.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-blush
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a blush fill, in both themes (9.6:1).

tokens.name: sunflower
tokens.usage: The sunflower of her captions, and the yellow of her workshop reels. Accent fills only: a sticker, a 'new' flag, a highlight bar. Text on it is on-sunflower.

tokens.name: on-sunflower
tokens.usage: Text on a sunflower fill (10.3:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders. Decorative dividers only; controls use line-strong.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and outline buttons (3:1 or better on canvas and paper).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on web: 2px solid neon, offset 2px.

styles.name: script-accent
styles.usage: The neon hand. One short phrase per layout at 40px or more: a sign-off, a 'thank you', the '&' in a headline. Never a sentence, never below 40px.

styles.name: poster
styles.usage: Workshop names on posters and reel covers, in capitals. One or two words.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section heads, story headlines, card titles.

styles.name: title-italic
styles.usage: Standfirst under a headline; pull quotes from participants.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text on web, flyers and cards.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Event facts inside a details block.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Spaced capitals: the descriptor under the wordmark, eyebrows above headlines, chip text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Rows inside a details block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; button padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Poster margins at 1080px wide are 3× this (96px).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section breaks on web.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, photo frames, details blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Poster panels and story cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and the date stamp. Round things echo the neon ring.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Floating cards over photos.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: The neon halo. Once per layout, on the primary button or the logo ring in Neon night.
